results.title: Greta Gerwig's Narnia Adaptation Sparks Controversy with Fever-Dream Trailer
results.description: The first trailer for Greta Gerwig's adaptation of C.S. Lewis's Narnia chronicles has ignited a firestorm of controversy online. While the film-maker celebrates capturing the surreal beauty of the Magician's Nephew, fans are divided, with many accusing the CGI-heavy production of lacking the charm and depth of the original stories.
